name: Lightplane Renderer
definition: A memory-efficient renderer for neural 3D fields that reduces memory usage by four orders of magnitude compared to standard autograd renderers. It solves the bottleneck of storing intermediate values for backpropagation by fusing operations over casted rays instead of 3D points.
summary: Lightplane Renderer is a memory-efficient differentiable component for neural 3D fields that reduces memory usage by four orders of magnitude by fusing operations over casted rays and recomputing forward activations during backpropagation.
